title: E1.2 parameter layer: W4 / S2 / R4 / M4 / M6 single-factor response curves

protocol.note: Every factor changes exactly one dotted config path from reference-r0.json. Levels equal to the reference value are deduplicated by the compiler into one shared baseline run; the analysis maps every requested level back to that run by config_hash, so a curve still reports every level.
protocol.wiring_note: Two requested paths do not exist as consumed knobs in this checkout. R4: planner.params.k is never read, and retrieve._k reads retrieval.k only when no explicit k is passed; the e2e executor passes k=15 explicitly (memlab/experiments/executor.py:143), so the CLI run cannot vary k. The R4 factor below still sweeps retrieval.k to measure and expose that harness block. S2 max_neighbors is accepted by config but GraphIndex.expand never reads it; its three levels are still run to show the expected no-difference curve and are flagged wired=false in the artifact.

factors.note: MetaSchemaExtractor records the value in structured.schema.fields; the offline extractor derives the same fact set for every value, so the A-level curve is expected to be flat.
false = evidence off, true = evidence on. Offline meta_schema always emits unit.evidence and never reads the flag, so the parameter is interface-only on this path.
Read by GraphKHopRetriever via graph.retrieval.params.k_hop and passed to GraphIndex.expand.
Declared parameter, not consumed: GraphIndex.expand(seeds, k_hop) has no max_neighbors argument. Kept in the matrix so the no-difference result is measured rather than assumed.

R4 planner k. retrieve._k reads retrieval.k only when no explicit k is passed; the e2e executor passes k=15 at executor.py:143, so this factor is measured as harness-blocked. planner.params.k is not read anywhere and is recorded in deferred.

Cross-encoder is optional; when sentence-transformers/model weights are absent the stage records a fallback and keeps the incoming order, so top_n is not applied. The offline curve is expected to be flat above the fixed candidate budget of 15.

deferred.reason: No code path reads planner.params.k. retrieve._k reads retrieval.k only when no explicit k is passed, and the e2e executor passes k=15 at executor.py:143, so both the declared path and the nominal retrieval.k path are inert in this harness. Running planner.params.k as its own factor would be a fake factor with identical behaviour at all levels; retrieval.k is swept above to quantify the harness block.
deferred.planned_in: only if a planner starts reading a per-plan k override; then re-add and compare against retrieval.k

analysis.note: A-level interface metrics only. answer_f1/judge are not reported for this offline run; offline-extractive is not an LLM answer and must not be read as a 27B result.
